# [CS062] Retracted Dependency Version (dependency-retracted)

The required version is retracted by the module's authors.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | HIGH |
| **Category** | Supply Chain & Provenance |
| **CWE** | [CWE-1395](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/1395.html) |
| **OWASP** | A03:2025 |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | No |

## Why It Matters in Go

Authors retract versions that are broken or were published by mistake, often for security reasons. The retraction and its rationale come from the go.mod of the module's latest version.

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```text
require github.com/acme/broken v1.0.3 // retract [v1.0.0, v1.0.5] // critical security bug
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```text
require github.com/acme/broken v1.0.6
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [dependency-retracted]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    dependency-retracted: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore dependency-retracted -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** dependency-retracted
```
